page_title: HopBase · Enterprise LLM API Gateway for Claude, GPT, Gemini & DeepSeek

sources.entry: HopBase - AI API gateway with one base URL for Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and Qwen text models plus image and video models such as Seedream, Seedance and Kling, compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini endpoints. #paid #api #llm

summary.name: HopBase
summary.one_liner: HopBase is an enterprise LLM API gateway that gives one OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible base URL for Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and other text, image and video models, with routing, failover, keys, quotas and cost tracking.
keywords: pay as you go ai api
use_cases: Point Claude Code or Codex CLI at a single gateway
Route chat and coding traffic across multiple model providers with failover
Issue scoped API keys and quotas per team, project or customer
Track AI usage for departmental chargebacks and customer billing
Generate short AI videos or images from prompts and scripts via API
Connect n8n, Dify or Cherry Studio to multiple LLMs through one endpoint
summary.what_it_does: HopBase exposes one OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint that routes requests to models from Claude, OpenAI/Codex, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, Grok and others, plus image and video models such as Seedream, Seedance, Kling, Wan and MiniMax. Integration is done by changing the base URL and API key, and the page shows Claude Code and SDK examples. It offers automatic failover across redundant routes, and organization, project, team and key-level quotas with optional key expiry and IP allowlists. Every call is logged with model, token counts, latency and status, and the Usage page can export CSV. Video and image products are billed per second or per image, and failed generations are stated as not billed.
notable: One base URL works with OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs and tools like Claude Code, Codex CLI, Dify and n8n
Key, member and department quotas with monthly reset plus per-request usage logging and CSV export
Covers text, image and video models (Seedream, Seedance, Kling, Wan) behind one account
Pay-as-you-go USD prepaid balance with no subscription; prepaid credits do not expire
caveats: Pricing is quoted case by case by the sales team; no public per-token price list beyond one example model price
Cloud provider direct access currently supports Opus models only
Video generation is billed per second and reference images carry an extra per-image charge
